title.en: UJI iBeacon RSS, both zones, the authors' default train/test configuration

dataset.name: ibeacon_rssi
dataset.crs: local (one frame per zone; see building)
dataset.citation: Mendoza-Silva, Matey-Sanz, Torres-Sospedra, Huerta, BLE RSS Measurements Dataset for Research on Accurate Indoor Positioning, Data 4(1), 12, 2019

protocol.name: official
protocol.summary: the dataset's own train/test files (the setting of most published numbers)

skips.en: 19-27 % of the test scans hear fewer than 3 beacons (11-12 % hear none): a model-based method cannot place them, and `indoorloc benchmark` requires an estimate for every row
skips.zh: 19-27% 的测试样本听到的信标少于 3 个（11-12% 一个也没有）：基于模型的方法无法定位，而 `indoorloc benchmark` 要求每条样本都有估计

notes.en: The two zones (geo = building 1, lib = 2) have separate frames and beacons; see the per-zone tables. Scans that heard no beacon (fill: all -104 dBm) are kept, as in the dataset.
notes.zh: 两个区域（geo = 楼栋 1，lib = 2）坐标系与信标各自独立，见逐区域表格。未听到任何信标的样本（填充后全为 -104 dBm）按数据集原样保留。

mean_error.definition: mean 2-D Euclidean distance between estimated and true positions, as reported (papers use the dataset's own coordinates)

floor_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose floor is estimated correctly (floor hit rate)

building_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose building is estimated correctly

literature.rule: shown: literature entries checked 'verified', 'corrected' or 'unchecked'; hidden: 'unidentified', 'missing' and numbers IndoorLoc 0.1 produced itself
